title: Cranberry Honeyed Bread
description: A sweet and savory bread recipe incorporating the unique flavors of honey and cranberries.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
In a large mixing bowl, combine bread, ukrainian honey, and cranberry.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in the prepared loaf pan.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let the bread cool in the pan for 5 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
